title: Model menu — effort, fast mode, other models

steps.path: Claude Code session → click the model chip
steps.headline: Effort and Fast mode as Settings cards — keep?
steps.changed: Effort is now a card like Remote Access's "Keep awake": its title, the segmented bar, and the one-line explanation inside. Fast mode is the standard switch row every Settings screen uses. The two sit 8px apart under the model list.
steps.notice: The menu is a little taller than before, because the explanation is back and the two are boxed.

steps.path: An OpenRouter session ("claude via openrouter") → click the model chip
steps.headline: The same menu for an OpenRouter session — keep?
steps.changed: Today this session gets a centred popup. Now it gets the same menu above the chip: search box, your starred models first, then the rest, fading after about six and a half rows, with Manage models… as the last row.
steps.notice: Sessions like this have no Effort or Fast mode (those are Claude Code features), so the menu ends at Manage models.
